title: Audit five-stage Tensor expansion accuracy at computed inputs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This answers [PR5056](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5056)'s explicit expansion-accuracy handoff. The predecessor proves that the computed expansion stays in its admitted disk; it does not account for all internal rounding errors in the axis telescope.

The new proof derives the exact five-residual identity for the unchanged signed A/convolution/B/normalization/extraction sequence, including its crop and scale restoration. Against the exact stored-factor row, its complex defect is strictly below

```
sqrt(2) [2^-p + 2^(2sigma-P) (n+6)/4].
```

Under the stated certified coefficient, production-window and exact primitive premises, the argument independently recovers the existing local Gaussian allowance `(sqrt(2)+2^-11)2^-p`. It then proves the original-coordinate recurrence `e_(i+1) <= delta_i + beta_i e_i` at the **computed** input, for every finite axis count. Errors are propagated through the exact linear operator; no linearity or Lipschitz property of the rounded program is assumed. Common-precision errors therefore admit the stated geometric sum instead of being charged by axis count alone. No new precision policy or downstream saving is installed.

This is a conditional source proof with finite conformance evidence. The exact residual identity needs only the stated arithmetic/page interface; comparison with the true Gaussian additionally retains the certified interval and production geometry contracts. Chirp, compression, final restored Fourier error, full CRT recovery, primitive/backend acceptance, physical cost and complete supplier admission remain separate. No selected frontier or κ changes.

- [PR5081](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5081) audits the compression suffix after chirp; it is not repeated. PR5286 is only retained interchange backing. The original physical expansion already states a coarse accuracy proposition: this work credits it and independently binds each actual residual, computed-input telescope and finite intermediate coordinate boundary.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.13, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/tensor-expansion-accuracy --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/tensor-expansion-accuracy
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/tensor-expansion-accuracy --check-source-history
```

- Registered ordinary and optimized modes pass with the same frozen receipt. No proof-relevant check depends on Python assertions. Live source bytes authenticate before import; transitive imports use a fresh private bytecode namespace.
- The unchanged actual prefix executes 64 Tiles, 128 Blocks and 3,776 internal signed truncations. A separately derived integer/Fraction model agrees with their outputs and complete traces and verifies the exact five-term defect identity. The 257 checker reference calls include repeated tile/control checks; they are not 257 additional physical Blocks.
- The two physical intermediate arrays are compared in full after undoing the actual coarse/short layout: 64 records per axis, including eight zero-padding records after axis 0. Those actual values feed the stored-map telescope. Axis 1 demonstrably carries nonzero prior error. An intermediate permutation preserving all norms is rejected.
- Arithmetic-only controls distinguish omission of every residual term, omission of internal restoration scale, and the false nonexpansive-rounding premise. They refute defective identities, not claim that each term is necessary in a particular loose upper bound. The unchanged fixture also executes its real outward-rounding and ownership/layout rejection controls.
- The source-produced p48/P80 fixture has reduced halos. It checks stored-page arithmetic and physical conformance, **not production Gaussian tail accuracy**. The written quantified argument and finite evidence have separate roles.
- Committed-byte/source-history verification passes for all 59 package-plus-input files. Two portable exports are byte-identical, and export validation passes. A fresh Git-free extraction of the final head passes optimized isolated execution in 59.475 seconds without changing files. Actual source-byte and frozen-receipt drift are rejected by the same executable/input bytes; the deliberately changed files are restored.

No coefficient catalogue regeneration, heavy production Tensor/native/Lean/Docker run, historical suite, complete CRT composition or selected scientific replay was performed. Hosted CI remains separate from these local checks. Delegated arithmetic/proof review is not independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Each needs its own pinned contract and fresh overlap check. This local proof does not automatically launch either campaign or admit a full multiplication theorem.
